product.name: Loose Fit Washed Hoodie
product.description: Loose-fit sweatshirt hoodie in heavyweight, washed-look cotton fabric with a generous but not oversized silhouette. Double-layered, wrapover hood, dropped shoulders, long sleeves, and a kangaroo pocket. Ribbing at cuffs and hem.
